item.title: House approves stopgap bill, averting government shutdown
item.description: The House of Representatives approved the stopgap funding bill late on Wednesday, averting a shutdown. The border funding dispute now moves to December budget talks.

item.title: Wall Street tumbles as tech sell-off deepens
item.description: US stocks fell sharply on Wednesday as a sell-off in technology shares deepened. The Nasdaq dropped 2.4 percent, its worst day in months.

item.title: US Senate passes stopgap funding bill hours before shutdown deadline
item.description: The US Senate approved a short-term funding bill on Tuesday, hours before a government shutdown deadline. The House is expected to vote on the measure on Wednesday.
